comparison.objective: Candidate sets a gripper motion limit; this record releases a camera plate from a cam-clamped mount and transfers it to a pad.
comparison.physical_skill: Candidate uses two coaxial tools to resist lock reaction; the record rotates a release cam, clears a separate rear lip, and supports a payload during removal.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate verifies retained opening after cycles; the record checks cam release, mount clearance, supported upright pad placement, release, and stability without dropping.
comparison.reason: Cam release and retained-payload dismounting test disengagement and transfer rather than calibration, countertorque, or post-lock functional retention.
